codes.meaning: Provider claims a semantic capability/version that cannot be resolved in the selected Registry Snapshot.
Provider declaration references semantic contract content that does not match the selected Registry Snapshot.
Provider execution class is outside the semantic capability contract envelope.
Provider implementation/runtime effect envelope exceeds the semantic capability contract allowed effects.
Provider declaration omits an effect required by every valid implementation/invocation of the semantic capability.
Provider declares runtime authority classes outside the semantic capability contract allowed authority envelope.
Provider declaration is incompatible with a semantic capability authority lower bound required for valid execution.
Provider runtime/network behavior requires egress mode not permitted by the semantic capability contract.
Provider-declared semantic ports/types do not conform to the referenced capability contract.
Provider cannot satisfy the minimum isolation/security profile required for the claimed capability/use context.
Provider conformance suite identity/hash is missing, stale, or does not match the semantic contract requirement.
Conformance evidence is not tied to an immutable provider/package/build identity.
Provider implementation failed one or more required conformance tests.
Conformance evidence is outside its accepted validity/retest policy window.
Provider manifest/registration declaration is structurally or semantically invalid.
